## About
McCrary's Auto Repair is a locally owned and operated shop on Trent Rd in Huffman, TX. We treat every customer like family and focus on keeping your vehicle safe, reliable and running its best.
Our ASE-certified mechanics handle everything from routine oil changes and brake repairs to check engine lights, suspension work and engines and transmissions. We give free estimates, explain what we find, and keep pricing transparent.
We're rated 4.9 on Google from 220 reviews. Give us a call or book online when your car needs attention.

## Services
- Full synthetic oil change special: Full synthetic oil and filter changes for gas and diesel vehicles. Ask about BG products too.
- 4-wheel alignments: Alignments done on our Hunter Hawkeye Elite alignment machine. ($89)
- Brake repair and replacement: We make sure your braking system is safe and reliable, with in-house rotor and drum machining and anti-lock (ABS) repairs.
- Tires: We're a Michelin, BF Goodrich and Uni Royal dealer and carry other major brands too. Tires are sold at cost.
- Road hazard with free rotate and balancing: Road hazard on your tires, with free rotate and balancing included.
- Engine diagnostics: Check engine light on? We use Snap on, Autel and Bosch equipment, plus factory Ford, GM and Chrysler programming, and explain what we find.
- Suspension, struts and shocks: From struts and shocks to full suspension rebuilds.
- AC and heater repair: Repairs to keep your air conditioning and heater working.
- OEM engines and transmissions: Original engine manufacturer (OEM) engines and transmissions.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer loaner cars?
A: Yes. Free loaner cars are available for approved customers. The driver must be 25 or older and add the vehicle to their insurance policy while driving it.

Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates are free.
